entities.name: Luís Gastão de Orléans e Bragança
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Luiz of Orléans-Braganza was a Brazilian royal claimant who served as head of the Vassouras branch of the Imperial House of Brazil from 1981 until his death. He was the eldest son of Prince Pedro Henrique of Orléans-Braganza and Princess Maria Elisabeth of Bavaria, and was regarded by his supporters as pretender to the defunct title of Emperor of Brazil.
